test_title: PYST 30: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BLEACHERS' is coded as '63' and 'ABACAS' is coded as '42'. How will 'FIZZY' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Number of letters in the word × 7 = Number code.**

'BLEACHERS' is coded as '63'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d2b47b2b8287fa05768e05bea318341d693d5a73854f91be9f5f2dcf5f57cb8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/121b33154aa9d8ae6d5ee6b6eeb16f15501c4b4f17c39bb822bb5dd83ddb7fe3.png] 

'ABACAS' is coded as '42'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52194dfdde3afe53581da6a41f913a2c8063639f109461e981e0d1e849a2c3d3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/606c360fec3b82303f6e4531ff59b73156bc31e1ea53c9fba2bd84201b1c3bdf.png] 

Similarly, '**FIZZY**' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68b98d66b79b59cb923a6507ea8ce8d04468bb4afa8d72f70fd6a3ff6ee25e79.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0ff52b594f4e819c7088182bfb44dae7ecf40ade00e539eed85ba588d649595.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "35".**
